635:t_004:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$

635:t_004:4.en:
$$カティ$$
「Understood! I'm counting on you, $$クジョウ$$!」

635:t_004:6.en:
$$カティ$$
「How many times do I have to tell you, it's Brigadier General...!」

635:t_004:10.en:
$$アンドレイ$$
「I'm counting on you to protect the Earth... and humanity, $c!」

635:t_006:1.en:
$$トロワ$$
「And that thing waiting behind them is...」

635:t_007:0.en:
$$ロックオン$$

$$アレルヤ$$

635:t_007:2.en:

635:t_007:3.en:

635:t_007:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「Quit whining, $$シンジ$$! Until $$刹那$$ gets here, we'll hold these guys off somehow!」

635:t_007:6.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Based on the force differential between us and the enemy and the pilots' level of exhaustion, the combat limit is judged to be 5 minutes.」

635:t_007:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「A horde this huge, in just these 5 minutes...」

635:t_007:8.en:
$n
「Our job isn't to wipe out the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$! It's to hold the line until $$刹那$$ gets here!」

635:t_007:9.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「There are $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ in the surrounding space too...! In these 5 minutes, we stop the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ in this area!」

635:t_007:12.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Since I'm going to live on, don't you die either.」

635:t_007:14.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Remember this too, $$ゼクス$$. Our fight doesn't end here.」

635:t_007:15.en:
$$グラハム$$
「As expected of that boy's ally... It seems he isn't the only one I have to surpass.」

635:t_007:16.en:
$$グラハム$$
「On this battlefield... I too will fight with my life on the line! But I dare say it!」

635:t_007:17.en:
$$グラハム$$

635:t_007:18.en:

635:t_007:19.en:

635:t_007:20.en:

635:t_007:21.en:

635:t_007:22.en:

635:t_007:27.en:

635:t_009:8.en:
$$トライア$$
